features.text: Available in three monochromatic finishes—Stainless Steel, Black, and White—offering versatility to match various kitchen aesthetics
Ultra-slim LED light strip adjusts from a warm white (2,700K) to a neutral white (4,000K), allowing for customizable lighting to match any ambiance
Dimmable lighting provides flexibility, operating at full brightness for cooking or at a lower setting for ambient illumination
600 CFM blower and the patented Peripheral Extraction provides excellent removal of cooking by-products while being extremely quiet
Four fan speeds, including a high-power setting, efficiently clear smoke, steam, and odors from the kitchen
Delay setting automatically turns off the fan and lights after 10 minutes, offering convenience and energy savings
Auto-stop shuts off the fan motor after three hours for safety and efficiency
Can be controlled via a smartphone or tablet by connecting to a user-friendly app, providing remote access and ease of use
Dishwasher-safe grease filters are easily removable, ensuring quick and effortless cleaning
Whisper-quiet operation with maximum efficiency allows for powerful ventilation without disruptive noise
Integrated sound absorber minimizes noise levels for a quieter cooking experience
